actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The fungus makes two Rotting Touch attacks.

actions.name: Rotting Touch
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 10 ft. Hit: 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage. Gargoyle Gargoyle

reactions.name: Shriek
reactions.text: Trigger: A creature or a source of Bright Light moves within 30 feet of the shrieker. Response: The shrieker emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of itself for 1 minute or until the shrieker dies. Violet Fungus

traits.name: Flyby
traits.text: The gargoyle doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.
